Name: Positional Accuracy Extension
Description: This extension conveys accuracy information where the boundaries of the horizontal and vertical regions are coincident. There may be many positional accuracy regions, possibly associated with vertical and horizontal accuracy regions conveyed respectively by the ACCVT and ACCHZ extensions. When vertical and horizontal accuracies are homogeneous over the whole extent of the Image Segment, the ACCPO extension contains a single positional accuracy region and the ACCVT and ACCHZ are not present.

NUM_ACPO.Name: Number of Positional Accuracy Regions
NUM_ACPO.Description: This field shall contain the number of positional accuracy regions to follow.

UNIAAH<NUM_ACPO>.Name: Unit of Measure for the AAHn Field
UNIAAH<NUM_ACPO>.Description: This field shall contain the units of measure (UoM) for the corresponding AAHn field or all BCS spaces (0x20) if the absolute horizontal accuracy is unknown or not applicable. Note original values are from DIGEST Ed. 2.1 Part 3-7.

AAH<NUM_ACPO>.Name: Absolute Horizontal Accuracy
AAH<NUM_ACPO>.Description: This field is omitted when UNIAAHn contains all BCS spaces (0x20). Otherwise, this field shall contain the absolute horizontal accuracy for the nth region of horizontal positional accuracy.

UNIAAV<NUM_ACPO>.Name: Unit of Measure for the AAVn Field
UNIAAV<NUM_ACPO>.Description: This field shall contain the units of measure (UoM) for the corresponding AAVn field or all BCS spaces (0x20) if the absolute vertical accuracy is unknown or not applicable. Note original values are from DIGEST Ed. 2.1 Part 3-7.

AAV<NUM_ACPO>.Name: Absolute Vertical Accuracy
AAV<NUM_ACPO>.Description: This field is omitted when UNIAAVn contains all BCS spaces (0x20). Otherwise, this field shall contain the absolute vertical accuracy for the nth region of positional accuracy.

UNIAPH<NUM_ACPO>.Name: Unit of Measure for the APHn Field
UNIAPH<NUM_ACPO>.Description: This field shall contain the units of measure (UoM) for the corresponding APHn field or all BCS spaces (0x20) if the point-to-point (relative) horizontal accuracy is unknown or not applicable.

APH<NUM_ACPO>.Name: Point-to-Point Horizontal Accuracy
APH<NUM_ACPO>.Description: This field is omitted when UNIAPHn contains all BCS spaces (0x20). Otherwise, this field shall contain the point-to-point (relative) horizontal accuracy for the nth horizontal positional accuracy region.

UNIAPV<NUM_ACPO>.Name: Unit of Measure for the APVn Field
UNIAPV<NUM_ACPO>.Description: This field shall contain the units of measure (UoM) for the corresponding APVn field or all BCS spaces (0x20) if the point-to-point (relative) vertical accuracy is unknown or not applicable.

APV<NUM_ACPO>.Name: Point-to-Point Vertical Accuracy
APV<NUM_ACPO>.Description: This field is omitted when UNIAPVn contains all BCS spaces (0x20). Otherwise, this field shall contain the point-to-point (relative) vertical accuracy for the nth positional accuracy region.

NUM_PTS<NUM_ACPO>.Name: Number of Points in the Bounding Polygon
NUM_PTS<NUM_ACPO>.Description: This field defines the number of points (coordinate pairs) that are used to define the bounding polygon of the nth region of positional accuracy. Coordinate values shall refer to the coordinate system and units defined in GEOPS (and possibly in PRJPS). Whenever possible, the first and last points should be the same in order to close the polygon (e.g., a rectangular region would report five points), although this is not a strict requirement. If the accuracy information applies to the entire Image Segment (the value of NUM_ACPO = 1 and the ACCVT and ACCHZ extensions are not present), then this field does not apply and will contain 000.

LON<NUM_PTS<NUM_ACPO>>.Name: Longitude / Easting
LON<NUM_PTS<NUM_ACPO>>.Description: This field shall be omitted when the value of NUM_PTSn is 000. Otherwise, this field shall contain the Easting (when the value of GEOPS.UNI is M) or Longitude (otherwise) of the mth polygon point.

LAT<NUM_PTS<NUM_ACPO>>.Name: Latitude / Northing
LAT<NUM_PTS<NUM_ACPO>>.Description: This field shall be omitted when the value of NUM_PTSn is 000. Otherwise, this field shall contain the Northing (when the value of GEOPS.UNI is M) or Latitude (otherwise) of the mth polygon point.
